[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for making a creamy soup without dairy:  
1. Add coconut milk or cream.  
2. Use vegetable stock instead of water.  
3. Blend some of the vegetables into the soup.  
4. Use starchy vegetables (potatoes, sweet potatoes, squash, parsnips).  
5. Add a spoonful of nut butter (cashew or almond butter).  
6. Try using silken tofu.  
[PREFERENCE] User plans to add coconut milk and blend in sweet potatoes to make their vegetable soup creamier.  
[USER] User has a quick question about using almond milk instead of coconut milk in soup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Confirmed that almond milk can be used as a dairy-free substitute for coconut milk but noted it has a lighter flavor. Suggested adding flour, cornstarch, or arrowroot powder to thicken it. Mentioned plant-based cream or half-and-half as thicker options.  
[PREFERENCE] User prefers to stick with coconut milk for now but will keep almond milk in mind for future recipes.

2. Tofu.

4. Nutritional yeast.  
5. Nuts or seeds.  
6. Greek yogurt.
